compression_level.description: Compression level from 0 (fastest) to 9 (best compression). Default is 6.

dictionary_size.description: Dictionary size limit in bytes. Can include multipliers like k, M, G (e.g., '8M', '512M').

match_length.description: Match length limit in bytes. Default is 36.

member_size.description: Member size limit for multimember files in bytes. Can include multipliers. Empty string disables the limit.

volume_size.description: Volume size limit in bytes. Can include multipliers. Empty string disables the limit.

keep_input.description: Keep (don't delete) input files after processing.

stdout.description: Write output to standard output, keeping input files.

test_integrity.description: Test compressed file integrity without decompressing.

recompress.description: Force re-compression of already compressed files.

strict_trailing.description: Exit with error if trailing data is present.

verbose.description: Be verbose. For more verbosity, use -vv (not directly supported by single bool, but implies -v).

check_lib.description: Compare version of lzlib.h with liblz.{a,so}.

loose_trailing.description: Allow trailing data seeming corrupt header.

files.description: List of files to process. If empty, stdin/stdout is used if configured.
